column1: # caps.tsv (t-19bb) — the one table of capped files: name, path (from the project root; "-" = the caller gives it), limit, unit, marker.
# Units are defined in tools/canon-go/internal/board/caps.go: words (ASCII-whitespace fields, as wc -w), block-lines (lines between
# <!-- marker:BEGIN --> and :END -->), kb (bytes of a file or of every file in a tree, rounded up; never du), files. Tab-separated.
